name: source-service-relative-paths
goal: Hide the implied Services source root in labels while preserving full file identities

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Service Source labels omit src/services/; hover path, accessible identity, GitHub destination and code action keep the complete path.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: The shared Source matrix checked links, row bounds and code modal but not redundant root labels. Extend fileLink text and the existing SSR selected-file matrix; retain full href/title assertions.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Immutable red checkpoint on310cb86db fails Source labels omit only the implied root; original destinations, row limits and code actions remain checked.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: SourceFileList accepts an optional display prefix. EntitySource supplies src/services/ only for service implementation labels; original paths still drive titles, accessibility, links and actions.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: The same frozen test corpus and stable environment pass on81ea4ed9e after310cb86db failed the label assertion. Original file identities, code actions, responsive row bounds and standalone lists remain checked.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
